title.en: Query the status of a task

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[StartMpuTask](~~93183~~)开始旁路转推任务。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为4000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes
Before you call this operation, you must have called [StartMpuTask](~~93183~~) to start a stream relay task.
# QPS limit
The per-user QPS limit on this operation is 4,000 calls per minute. If the number of calls per minute exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered, which may affect your business. Therefore, we recommend that you call this operation at a reasonable frequency. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~341645~~).
